title: Absoluteness of tensor pullback derived comparison
statement: The K-flat derived comparison remains a left derived comparison after postcomposition with every functor out of the target derived category.

proof.text: Every homotopy object admits a quasi-isomorphism from the image of a K-flat complex, by quotient_obj_surjective and exists_isKFlatResolution. Use the right calculus and two-out-of-three for quasi-isomorphisms.

For any postcomposition H, naturality of epsilon identifies F(s) between K-flat objects as inv(epsilon_X) followed by L(Qh(s)) followed by epsilon_X'. Thus F followed by H inverts these arrows. Resolving-class essential constancy, the Stacks-to-Kan bridge and Mathlib totalLeftDerived give a derived pair (R,alpha) for F followed by H, with alpha invertible on K-flat objects.

The universal lift phi from L followed by H to R satisfies phi at Qh(X) followed by alpha_X equals H(epsilon_X). Both comparison components are invertible on K-flat objects, hence so is phi there. Naturality along a K-flat resolution makes phi invertible at every Qh(X), and essential surjectivity of Qh makes it invertible everywhere. Mathlib isLeftDerivedFunctor_iff_isIso_leftDerivedLift now proves the desired postcomposed universal property.

proof_origin.place: Tag 06XN, dual resolving-class argument; Mathlib pointwise Kan-extension assembly and uniqueness. For concrete inverse image and extension of scalars, Tags 06YC, 06YJ and 06YT.

lean.statement:
theorem leftDerived_tensorPullback_absolute
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))]
    (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))
    (h : ∀ M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y),
      P.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap g.hom.base X.sheaf Y.sheaf ⟨g.hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g.hom.base Y.sheaf M))
    (hm : ∀ {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)} (a : M ⟶ N),
      P.map a = eqToHom (h M) ≫ SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap g.hom.base X.sheaf Y.sheaf ⟨g.hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g.hom.base Y.sheaf M)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap g.hom.base Y.sheaf M a) ≫
        eqToHom (h N).symm)
    [P.Additive]
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)))
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
      P.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hL : L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hK : ∀ K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) ℤ,
      K.IsKFlat → IsIso
        (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K))) :
    ∀ H : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)),
      (L ⋙ H).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
        ((Functor.associator _ _ _).inv ≫ Functor.whiskerRight ε H)
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
